part.text: Fixed. The alert regex in markup/goldmark/blockquotes/blockquotes.go:251 is now case-insensitive via the `(?i)` flag, so `[!note]`, `[!Note]`, etc. are recognized as GitHub alerts (alert type is already lowercased downstream). All blockquotes/goldmark/markup tests pass; the hugolib failures are pre-existing environment issues (missing asciidoctor/pandoc binaries and no network for dependency download), unrelated to the change.
